instruction: Change Chrome's default font size to Large.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to find electric cars on cars.com but encountered ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR. Spent all 50 turns trying to access cars.com via Chrome, Firefox, curl, and Python requests. Investigated proxy settings but could not bypass the connection issue.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome, type URLs in address bar, open terminal, run bash/curl/Python commands, open Firefox, navigate Chrome UI menus, investigate system settings
metadata.failure_analysis: cars.com was inaccessible due to HTTP/2 protocol errors through the configured proxy. The model could not complete the original task because the target website was unreachable, not due to agent capability limitations.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original external-website task into a Chrome settings modification task that uses chrome:// internal pages, which are always accessible regardless of proxy/network issues. Tests the model's ability to navigate Chrome settings UI.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome settings and changing font size to Large (value 20). Evaluator uses official check_font_size metric with chrome_font_size getter to verify the setting was changed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (chrome_font_size) correctly reads Chrome Preferences JSON and extracts webkit.webprefs dict containing default_font_size
Metric (check_font_size) correctly accesses font_size['default_font_size'] and compares against rule['value'] (20)
Expected value 20 correctly corresponds to Chrome's 'Large' font size setting
Metric parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', framework passes rules dict directly as rule parameter, and metric accesses rule['type'] and rule['value'] correctly
Single-step instruction with complete verification coverage
